_note: Masala Shorts (Entertainment With Manzi). One AI clip per scene, made upright (9:16) for 8 s, with the Hindi line spoken inside the clip: nothing is stretched or frozen. max_words_per_clip comes from the lip-sync tests (about 1.5 words a second). About 10-12 min of Kaggle GPU per clip.
_note_pace: Final Short: each clip is cut to its speech (lead s before the first word, tail s after the last; a scene without a line keeps silent_max s) and played speed x faster. Drafts are not cut.
